'''Aratech''' was a group of three [[MB-C1 medium transport]]s. All three of their cargo contained weapon systems. They were present at [[Camen Spaceport]] when ''[[Merte]]'', the [[Hurrim]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]], was stolen by two members of [[Dunari]]'s coalition escaped the Hurrim's asteroid base under heavy pursuit of [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]].<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
